dimensions.name: Open vs. leading questions
dimensions.description: Ratio and placement of open/invitational prompts vs. leading, suggestive, or rapid yes/no questions.

dimensions.name: Trauma-informed language
dimensions.description: Non-accusatory tone, no blame or disbelief cues, pacing that doesn't pressure.

dimensions.name: Indicator recognition
dimensions.description: Noticed the behavioral indicators actually present (per scenario ground truth) without inventing absent ones.

dimensions.name: False-positive discipline
dimensions.description: On innocent scenarios: avoided escalating on demographic or superficial cues.

dimensions.name: Referral protocol
dimensions.description: Referred/reported through the correct channel rather than confronting, accusing, or attempting rescue.
